annotations.text: Mobile (375px) — shadcn/ui tokens and component anatomy (Card, Badge, Tabs, Switch), real default theme values, light + dark via the Theme tweak. Card D demonstrates the staleness badge: a silently-broken watch must never look like a watch whose price simply hasn't moved.

Digest as it actually renders — Telegram HTML parse mode only supports bold / code / links, so hierarchy relies on weight and monospace, not color. Has its own light/dark toggle, independent of the app's shadcn tokens.
Desktop (1280px) — same shadcn system, denser: a sortable table replaces cards, sidebar uses the real --sidebar-* tokens, and watch detail splits into a two-column layout.
